title: Internal communication standards
summary: A demonstration guide to concise updates, ownership, context and appropriate use of synchronous versus asynchronous communication.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: State what changed, what is needed, who owns the next action and when another update is expected when timing matters.

items: Name the owner of the next action
Include a deadline only when one is real
Link the relevant source instead of duplicating it

blocks.text: Use asynchronous communication by default when the subject can be understood and resolved without a meeting. Use a call when nuance, speed or active collaboration materially improves the result.

blocks.label: After a call
blocks.text: If the conversation creates a decision, commitment or change that matters later, preserve the relevant conclusion in the appropriate written record.
Escalation should describe the blocker, consequence and requested decision. Adding more recipients without clarifying the need rarely improves the outcome.
